findings.title: Agent workflow triggered by pull_request_target
findings.why: pull_request_target runs with the base repository's secrets and write token on events from forks. An agent that reads the fork's PR text or code can be told to leak or misuse them.
findings.fix: Use pull_request for agent jobs, or split the job so the agent never sees secrets or a write token while it reads outside content.

findings.title: MCP server installed from an unpinned package
findings.why: npx/uvx/bunx fetch the newest version at every start. A hijacked or malicious update becomes code running with your agent's access, with no review.
findings.fix: Pin an exact version (for example pkg@1.4.2), or install it once from a reviewed lockfile.

suppressed_findings.title: Agent runs with all permission checks turned off
suppressed_findings.why: Every tool call, including shell commands and file deletes, runs without approval. One prompt injection in a file, issue or web page the agent reads can run any command as you.
suppressed_findings.fix: Remove the bypass. Allow specific tools instead, and run unattended agents in a throwaway sandbox with no secrets and no network beyond what the task needs.
